missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.why_missing: Agent generates coverage reports; Observer should ingest these as observables. Currently not connected.
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.location: unified-coverage-agent.md does not reference observer_phase; observer_phase.py does not list coverage data as input
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.impact: OODA does not know about coverage changes; orientation decisions lack coverage context
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.recommendation: Add explicit integration: Observer → read coverage report → add to observable state

missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.why_missing: Workflow failures and successes should be learned patterns stored in LTM. Currently logged but not integrated with pattern graph.
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.impact: Workflow failure patterns not learned; agents cannot apply historical knowledge
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.recommendation: Post-workflow hook: execute pattern_learn.py to extract and store workflow outcome patterns

missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.why_missing: Dependency security findings should automatically trigger RBAC restriction if critical. Currently findings are reported but not connected to RBAC rules.
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.location: dependency-security-review-agent.md does not reference RBAC module; RBAC rules do not have integration hook for agent findings
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.impact: Security findings do not automatically restrict risky operations
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.recommendation: Create event trigger: Security finding → RBAC policy amendment

missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.why_missing: Quantum orchestrator exists but is not integrated with session state. No way for quantum logic to checkpoint or resume.
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.location: src/codex/brain/quantum_*.py has no imports from session_serializer.py
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.impact: Quantum decisions are not reproducible; no audit trail

missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.why_missing: When workflows fail, RBAC permissions should adapt (e.g., restrict PRs from failing branches). Currently no feedback loop.
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.location: CI/CD workflows do not call RBAC update; RBAC does not listen to workflow events
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.impact: RBAC is static; does not adapt to operational reality
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.recommendation: Workflow event handler: parse result → update RBAC rules dynamically

missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.why_missing: Agents are dispatched but session context (cycle ID, checkpoint state) is not always injected. Some agents run in isolation.
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.location: agent_dispatch.py line 180: context_injection is conditional; not all agents receive context
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.impact: Some agents cannot recover from checkpoints; isolated decisions not auditable
missing_edges_in_dependency_graph.recommendation: Enforce context injection for all agent dispatch paths

circular_dependencies.cycle: Agents depend on OODA for context; OODA depends on agents for execution; Session depends on both for checkpointing
circular_dependencies.mitigation: Currently mitigated by strict interface contracts; event-driven decoupling
circular_dependencies.risk: If contracts are violated, system deadlock possible

circular_dependencies.cycle: Workflows dispatch agents; agents report status; workflows depend on status to continue
circular_dependencies.mitigation: Callback/event pattern used; no true circular dependency
circular_dependencies.risk: Low if event handlers are idempotent (currently enforced)

circular_dependencies.cycle: RBAC determines agent permissions; agent output influences RBAC rules; governance enforces both
circular_dependencies.nature: Desired feedback loop (not a bug; by design)
circular_dependencies.risk: Policy oscillation if feedback gain too high
